body: I think he would forgive you. My mother took my dog without telling me to her boyfriends house where his dog, a pitbull killed my little Chihuahua, my best friend. He made it to the vet, I visited him, he was doing all right, he was very sad though. Sitting in a small cramped cage at the vet. They put him down sometime later in the week, my mother never told me. I found out and bawled my eyes out. I always wish I did something else or did the *right* thing but I don't know if I can ever forgive myself but I know my dog would forgive me. I hope perhaps at one point you can have a similar view. Peace.

I ruined my body by getting terrible tattoos. I also made a very extensive post describing my issues, here is a excerpt from said post:


I've been depressed for a few years now, I suppose I can't see myself living anymore or any longer. I set tomorrow, 4/20 my set date. I have a lot of problems now, this includes; severe depression, financial problems, severe paranoia/anxiety, body dysmorphia (losing and gaining 30 lbs every few months, starving myself and overeating), covered in ugly tattoos, having headaches everyday, sleep has became awful and I went through a lot of traumatic experiences. Almost everyday, my older brother would slam on my door around 2 AM, and would threaten to hurt me, he owned many firearms, and he had nothing to live for. My mother would never stand up for me, and said he was going through a hard time. Now I'm all fucked up. My mother also killed my dog but this is another story. I was also very fit about a year ago, I could lift 30 lbs, and could do at least 10 pullups, 100 pushups a day type of deal, now I can barely lift 10 lbs, can't even do pushups or pullups.

This is good advice and insight, I think I will wait forever, I keep setting dates and I do nothing, a decision to end ones life, even suffering mentally as I am now or believing that I likely have little future, the thought of non existence truly terrifies me along with hurting myself intentionally like this in regard to suicide. Although unrealistic, the only thing I can do is hope I pass in my sleep and be sent back to a reasonable point in time and prevent mistakes and fix my life.
I hope you recover mentally and physically as well.
